name: Rhea Okonkwo
bio: Once wore Compact colors and believed the cordon line was worth holding. She's spent every year since proving that was a lie.

deploy: Ferrous, moving up.
Wing Lead in the air. Form on me.
I've done this before. Follow the plan.
attack: This one's for the ones who didn't get out.
crit: Clean hit. That's how it's done.
kill: That's the last mistake he makes today.
hit: I've had worse from friendly fire.
allyDown: No — get eyes on their mech, now!
Stay with me! Stay with me!
I said hold the line, not die on it!
retreat: Pull back — this fight isn't worth it.
Regroup at the Lantern. Move!
lines.finisher: Fifteen years of debt. Call it paid — Iron Verdict!

name: Jax Calder
bio: Youngest pilot Relay's got, and the first to volunteer for anything with a fuse on it. Everyone's waiting for the day his nerve outruns his skill.

deploy: Tinder's up! Let's light this up.
Finally — thought you'd never call.
Say the word, I'm already moving.
attack: Too slow, too slow, too slow!
allyDown: No no no — hang on!
They're gonna pay for that!
Get up, get up, come on!
retreat: Aw, come on, we were winning!
Fine — fine! Falling back!
rivalContact: You're all anyone talks about. Let's see it.
lines.finisher: No brakes, no regrets — Full Burn!

name: Imogen Reyes
bio: Doesn't waste words or shots. She clocked the rival's targeting pattern after one engagement and hasn't missed a read since.

deploy: Halo, in position.
Sightlines clear. Standing by.
Give me an angle and give me a minute.
allyDown: I see the shooter. Everyone hold.
Marking their position — don't move.
That wasn't supposed to happen.
retreat: Covering the withdrawal.
Falling back — final shot's mine.
rivalContact: Your accuracy's slipping. I've been counting.
Same opening every time. I noticed.
lines.finisher: Every variable accounted for — Dead Reckoning.

name: Toby Wren
bio: Six weeks out of the training loop and already flying combat. The whole squad has quietly agreed to keep him alive whether he likes it or not.

deploy: Sprout, uh, ready! I think!
Okay. Okay. I can do this.
Here goes nothing!
kill: I got one! I really got one!
One down, don't tell my mom!
hit: That was close, that was so close!
allyDown: No, get up, please get up!
Somebody help them, please!
I'll cover you, just hold on!
retreat: Falling back, falling back!
I don't want to die today!
rivalContact: That's — that's the ace, isn't it?
Everyone said stay away from that one!

name: Priya Anand
bio: Talks to the frames more than the pilots most days, and swears half of them talk back. If your mech's still moving after a bad hit, thank her.

deploy: Wrench is up. Diagnostics look good.
Everybody's frame checked out this morning. You're welcome.
In position. Kits ready.
kill: That's one less thing to fix.
allyDown: Get them out, I'll patch what's left!
Hang on — I'm coming to you!
Not their frame too — no!
retreat: Pulling back, covering repairs as we go.
Fall back — I'll keep you all running.
rivalContact: That frame's beautiful work. Shame about the pilot.
I'd love five minutes with their engineers.

name: Nadia Osei
bio: Flew recon before Relay existed and knows every debris lane and dead zone in the Cordon by feel. She sees the fight three minutes before it starts.

deploy: Compass, pushing ahead.
I'll find the gap. Give me a minute.
Scouting the approach now.
crit: Exactly where I said it'd be.
allyDown: I should've seen that coming — I'm sorry!
Their position's marked, don't let it stand!
Damn it, I missed that one!
victory: Clear all the way to the horizon.
retreat: I know a way out — follow me!
Falling back through the debris lane!
rivalContact: I've tracked your patrol for weeks. Finally.
You move different when you're worried.
lines.finisher: Gone before you register it — Vanishing Point!

name: Emil Torres
bio: Was a mining-colony tech before the Compact cordon took his home off the map. He flies whatever Relay can spare and fixes what nobody else wants.

deploy: Scrapper's in. Let's earn our keep.
This old frame's got one more fight in it.
In the air. Watch my flank.
attack: Take it — we need the parts anyway!
kill: Down. Check the wreck for parts!
One more piece of the system back.
hit: Held up better than it looks!
allyDown: No — not another one, come on!
I'll get their frame back, I promise!
We don't leave people out here!
victory: We hold what's left. That's enough.
Everyone gets to go home tonight.
retreat: Pulling back — grab what you can!
Not worth losing anyone. Fall back!
rivalContact: You people did this to my home.
Funny — your frame's built from someone's colony too.
lines.finisher: Nothing wasted, nothing forgiven — Salvage Rites!

name: Zephyr Lin
bio: Shows up in Relay's records only after the rival's first appearance, and won't say why. Flies like someone who has already died once.

deploy: Wraith's up. Don't ask where I learned this.
In position. Try to keep up.
Here. Not staying long, though.
attack: You don't want to know where I trained.
Let's see if you're as good as they said.
Not my first time doing this.
crit: Didn't even have to think about it.
kill: One less ghost to worry about.
allyDown: Damn it — not like this, not again!
I've seen this before. I hate it.
Hold on, I'm not losing anyone else!
retreat: Falling back. Live to fight the real one.
Not today. Pulling out.
rivalContact: Last time we met, I lost. Not again.
lines.finisher: You should've remembered me — Ghost Protocol!

name: Corvin Ashe
bio: The Compact's finest ace, flying a frame built from three salvage yards and pure spite. He intercepts every Relay run personally — it's become a point of pride.

deploy: Duskfang, inbound. Let's see what Relay's sending this time.
Another rescue run. How predictable.
I was hoping it'd be you again.
attack: Is this really the best the Cordon has left?
crit: There. Was that so hard to see coming?
hit: Lucky. Don't get used to it.
allyDown: Reform and press on.
Careless. Watch your spacing.
Acceptable losses. Continue.
retreat: Not worth finishing today. Falling back.
I'll see you next time, Relay.
rivalContact: Lantern. You brought the whole family this time.
You have been busy. It will not be enough.
I was starting to think you were avoiding me.
lines.finisher: I don't lose twice — Last Word!

name: Elias Vantry
bio: Commands the Lantern and speaks every order the crew hears. He's buried more pilots than he'll ever talk about and refuses to lose count anyway.

deploy: This is Vantry. Get them home.
attack: Not my place to fight. Just to call it.
allyDown: We do not leave anyone behind. Understood?
retreat: Pull back. That's an order, not a request.

name: Ilya Petrenko
bio: Compact rank-and-file, flying whatever the depot issues. Doesn't get a name in most Relay after-action reports.

deploy: Iron-1, moving to position.
allyDown: Iron-2 is down!
retreat: Falling back to formation.

name: Soren Dahl
bio: Transferred in from a border garrison. Follows orders without complaint and without much thought either.

deploy: Iron-2, in formation.
allyDown: Iron-1 is down!
retreat: Withdrawing.

name: Yara Nasser
bio: Believes the cordon keeps people safer than it hurts them, and flies like she means it.

deploy: Iron-3, moving up.
allyDown: Iron-1 is down, cover me!
retreat: Pulling back.
